text:
I was attending by Dr Phanchanit for general cleaning and refilling my tooth.
She was very knowledgeable, skillful and professional .

Strong recommendation from me.

This is a must-visit orthodontic and dental clinic!
Is the wait time long? Haha. I had an appointment on Wednesday and was treated on Saturday because the specialist dentist is available on Saturdays. It was super fast!
The dentist is very kind and gentle. I didn't need anesthesia. They treated my innermost molars, and it didn't hurt at all. They also aligned my teeth perfectly. I can eat deliciously again now!
The price is very reasonable. You can rest assured. I had high expectations for the price when I was getting it done, but I was surprised by the price when the assistant told me. It was very affordable.
They accept all cases, whether foreigners or Thais. You can go in for a consultation.
The clinic is located next to Mahathun Plaza building, on the left side of the building.
❤️❤️❤️

text: Easy to get to. The clinic might look a bit old-fashioned, but the inside is clean, spacious, and the atmosphere is very friendly. The colors aren't gaudy like some clinics that make you feel dizzy. The equipment is complete and impressive. I was very impressed with the service. Appointments are taken quickly and run efficiently; I never had to wait long. The doctor explained the treatment in detail and was very gentle. The dental assistant was also very kind.
